args.title: Fix README "Running locally" step referencing missing npm run serve script
args.body: File: README.md. The "Running locally" section tells users to run `npm run serve` after `npm run build`, but no such script exists in package.json, causing a "Missing script: serve" error for new contributors. Update the README to reference the correct start command (e.g. `npm start` or whatever script actually boots the API), verifying it against package.json's scripts section so the documented steps match reality.
